fusions.name: Snapped Lengths
fusions.desc: Snaps a length of linked scales at the first enemy it meets, dealing 4 damage, then leaps to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles for 60% of that.

fusions.name: Anchor Hook
fusions.desc: Throws a hooked scale on a length of links, dealing 12 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at its full reach of 5 tiles. The target is left [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds and 20% slower for 3 seconds, and your afflictions on it spread to every enemy within 3.5 tiles.

fusions.name: Dragline
fusions.desc: Anchors a 5-tile length of linked scales ahead of you for 5 seconds. It drags every enemy near it inward and slows those it catches by 25% for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Slack Taken Up
fusions.desc: Against enemies carrying your afflictions, your armour is 12% higher.
